plan.name: Repair review findings before publication
plan.summary: After a plumbing build passes its checks and a second agent asks for changes, give the review's findings to the same builder in its existing workspace under the unchanged ratified plan, allowing at most two repair attempts, each followed by fresh factory checks and, if those pass, a fresh read-only review of the whole candidate against the original checkout; publish ready only when the final checks pass and the final review approves, otherwise publish a draft for a person with the unresolved findings even when a repair fails its tests or runs out of time. Permit new regular Go *_test.go regression files in the packages the plan touches, including the nearest Go package owning a planned embedded asset and new packages named by the plan, through staging, formatting, package tests, final copying and CI scope checks, without permitting changes to existing unnamed tests, the ratified acceptance tests or plan, other production files or unrelated packages; keep the original baseline fixed so tests added in one repair can be corrected or removed in the next. Keep all builder, fallback, repair and reviewer usage in the build's totals and preserve their transcripts and test logs, sharing one execution time allowance across the build, checks and reviews without renewing it per round or fallback, while preserving the existing exclusion of waits for an agent account's turn. Tell reviewers to list decision recording and checks that require unavailable Docker or network access under Merger work and approve when that is all that remains, and update the planning, building and proposal wording to explain the regression-test allowance, updating only the expected proposal text in TestClippedPlanKeepsRatificationInstructions in internal/factory/closing_commands_accept_test.go to match the new wording while keeping its clipping, separator and marker checks unchanged. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe these repairs, limits, accounting, file boundaries and merger responsibilities, including the plumbing exception to SPEC's existing fallback-timeout wording, cite the recorded foundation D-0105, D-0107, D-0108, D-0109, D-0110, D-0122, D-0125, D-0133 and D-0154 where applicable, and state that the merger must record issue #281's new repair, regression-test and merger-work policy because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestReviewFindingIsRepairedBeforeAReadyPullRequest
tests.says: An in-scope review finding returns to the same builder workspace, gets fixed and covered by an added regression test, passes fresh checks and review, and publishes one ready pull request with its ratified inputs unchanged and every round's logs retained.

tests.name: TestReviewFindingOutsideThePlanGoesToAPerson
tests.says: A finding needing a different plan is offered to the builder but cannot expand its writable scope, and reaches a person in the failure post for a draft pull request.

tests.name: TestReviewRepairsStopAfterTwoAttempts
tests.says: Persistent findings cause exactly two repair attempts and fresh reviews before draft publication with the last findings; a regression test removed in the final repair stays removed.

tests.name: TestMergerWorkAloneApprovesWithoutARepair
tests.says: Review instructions distinguish decision recording and unavailable Docker or network checks as merger work, and a review listing only those duties approves a ready pull request with its checklist and no repair.

tests.name: TestFailedRepairKeepsTheReviewFindingsInTheFailurePost
tests.says: A repair that fails package tests leaves a draft for a person and retains both the failed checks and the unresolved review findings in the failure post.

tests.name: TestPlumbingReviewRepairCountsEveryAgentsUsage
tests.says: The initial run, loop-guard fallback, repair and every reviewer call contribute their turns, cost, token fields and tool calls to the same build's totals.

tests.name: TestPlumbingReviewRepairsShareOneTimeLimit
tests.says: Repairs receive only the time remaining after the initial build and review, and expiry prevents further work or approval.

tests.name: TestReviewRegressionFilesAreStagedAndFormattedWithinThePlan
tests.says: Staging admits and formats newly added Go regression tests in a touched package while preserving trusted plan and acceptance bytes, excluding unrelated edits and refusing to copy linked host files.

tests.name: TestReviewRegressionTestsStayInTheirPlanPackages
tests.says: CI scope accepts new regular Go test files only in plan-touched packages, including embedded assets' owning packages, and preserves acceptance tests, existing unnamed tests, production scope and trusted-base classification.
